description: This file defines a Swift enum 'LaunchAgentManager' with static methods for managing macOS LaunchAgents, including checking status, enabling/disabling, generating plist contents, and running launchctl commands.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Checks if the LaunchAgent plist exists and whether the launchctl process reports it as loaded.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the LaunchAgent based on the 'enabled' parameter, and manages plist writing and launchctl commands.

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Generates and writes the LaunchAgent plist file to the specified URL.

methods.name: plistContents
methods.description: Returns the XML string representing the plist configuration with embedded paths and environment variables.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: Executes launchctl commands asynchronously and returns the process's termination status.

calls: try? plist.write(to: self.plistURL, atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)
